transcript.text: lg w/d keeps saying dE n wont start?? door is shut

LG’s dE display is commonly associated with the machine not detecting a properly closed/locked door, although I can’t confirm the exact code meaning without the model. Even when the door looks shut, a sock caught in the seal, a misaligned door catch, or a failing door interlock can stop it starting. Switch it off and unplug it first. Check all round the door seal for trapped clothing, then close the door firmly until you hear/feel a click. Look at the small hook on the door and the slot it enters: if the hook is damaged, loose, or the door has sagged, that points to the catch/hinge; if it all looks sound but dE remains, the door interlock is the more likely fault and usually needs an engineer to replace it safely.
ok checked, theres a duvet bulging against the glass and a corner squashed in the seal. hook looks fine. it closes but springs back a bit

That trapped duvet corner is very likely the immediate cause. If the door springs back, the latch cannot stay fully engaged, so the LG correctly shows dE rather than starting. With it switched off and unplugged, clear the duvet completely from the seal—do not force the door against it—then shut the empty door firmly. If it stays closed and the code clears when you restart, redistribute the duvet loosely in the drum before trying again; if it still springs open with nothing in the seal, the likely remaining fault is the door latch/interlock or door alignment and it will need repair.
ok took the duvet out and tried towels instead, starts fine. so is the duvet too big or what?

Yes — it was too bulky or positioned too far forward, rather than a fault with the machine. The duvet was pressing into the glass and seal, so the door could not stay fully latched and the machine correctly showed dE. Load the duvet loosely but keep it pushed well back into the drum, with no corners near the seal; use a duvet/bulky-items programme if available. A duvet can also become unbalanced during spin, so it may need washing on its own or with a couple of light items only if the care label permits. As the towels start normally, the door lock and catch appear to be working.

candidates: Door not latching due to trapped item, misalignment or catch issue (high)
Control or wiring fault to the door lock (low)
